Short day overview and thanks
A long month owed much to the front-counter team. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways maintained a steady focus on animal welfare, careful handling, and clear communication throughout the period. Service remained reassuring for travelers, and concerns were addressed with patience and respect.

The desk worked closely with handlers and the welfare coordinator to support calm boarding, gentle transfers, and suitable waiting arrangements. <<FACT F047>> Staff continued to watch for signs of stress and responded with quiet, humane practices that protected comfort and confidence.

Customer contact remained professional and prompt. Travelers received consistent guidance on paperwork, travel conditions, and accepted carrier standards, which helped reduce confusion at the counter. The team also kept internal notes clear enough to support smooth handovers between shifts, and that discipline reduced avoidable delays.

Overall, the month showed sound control, good teamwork, and a respectful approach to every animal in care. The next month should benefit from the same steady standards, with continued attention to welfare, courtesy, and timely updates.
